title: Sheffield Edwards gives the green light at the Fontainebleau Hotel
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Sheffield Edwards gives the green light at the Fontainebleau Hotel, about 1960 at Fontainebleau Hotel, Miami, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest named Dan Sheehan, speaking on a podcast episode about UFOs and President John F. Kennedy, tells of a 1960 meeting at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami. Sheehan says another man joined the meeting under the cover name "Mr. Ed", and that this man was Sheffield Edwards, who gave the go-ahead for what was being planned there. He names others linked to the meeting as Santos Trafficante, Johnny Roselli, Bob Maheu and Sam Giancana, and tells it because, if true, it ties secret government dealings to the story he goes on to tell about Kennedy.
